environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-west-2 VPC behind ALB with AWS WAF WebACL. WAF association uses a custom rate-based rule (AggregateKeyType: FORWARDED_IP with fallback to IP, limit: 100 requests per 5-minute window per source) combined with scope-down statement matching URI path /api/. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule with fixed-response 429 for requests exceeding concurrent connection threshold via connection-level tracking. The Fargate task runs with ECS Service Connect proxy (Envoy) configured with circuit_breakers max_pending_requests=10 and per_connection_buffer_limit_bytes=32768. The service mesh layer applies local rate limiting via envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit token bucket (max_tokens: 5, tokens_per_fill: 1, fill_interval: 30s) scoped to the /api/v1/allocate path specifically.
